+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Retirement gate for local proxies and model providers (#5610).
+#
+# When retiring a provider door, systemd unit, or proxy component,
+# this gate verifies that no active references to that provider ID
+# remain in OpenCode configuration files (repo tracked config,
+# user deployed config, and runtime state configs).
+#
+# "Active" means a configuration value: JSONC comments (// line and
+# /* */ block) are stripped before searching, so retirement history
+# recorded in comments does not block a retirement whose real
+# references are gone (PR #7679 Codex finding 4506184819).
+#
+# Matching is by provider identity, not arbitrary substring: a
+# reference is a quoted provider key ("<id>": ...) or a model
+# reference ("<id>/<model>"). An ID that is merely a substring of an
+# unrelated provider, package, or model name (retiring "opencode"
+# while "opencode-route/workhorse" exists) does not block
+# (PR #7679 Codex finding 4506371633).
+#
+# Entries in a "disabled_providers" array are tombstones, not active
+# references: the tracked config REQUIRES that already-retired
+# providers stay listed there, because removing an entry reactivates
+# the provider through the catalog. Those entries are blanked before
+# searching (PR #7679 Codex finding 4506484591).
+#
+# Usage:
+#   scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh [options] <provider-id> [provider-id...]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --config <path>   Explicit config file to check (may be repeated).
+#   --allow-empty     Succeed even if no config files exist on disk.
+#   -h, --help        Show this help message.
+#
+# Exit codes:
+#   0: No references found across checked configs (safe to retire)
+#   1: Active references exist (retirement BLOCKED)
+#   2: Usage error / missing files / a config that could not be searched
+#      (fail closed: an unreadable config is never "no references")
+set -euo pipefail
+
+usage() {
+  cat <<'EOF'
+Usage: scripts/check-provider-retirement-gate.sh [options] <provider-id> [provider-id...]
+
+Check that no configuration references remain for a provider before retiring its
+service unit, proxy script, or network port (#5610).
+
+Options:
+  --config <path>   Explicit config file to check (can be specified multiple times).
+  --allow-empty     Exit 0 if no config files exist on disk.
+  -h, --help        Show this help message.
+
+Exit codes:
+  0: Safe to retire — zero references found across all checked config files.
+  1: Retirement BLOCKED — active references found.
+  2: Configuration error or invalid usage (including a config file that
+     could not be read/searched — the gate fails closed).
+EOF
+}
+
+# Strip JSONC comments from a config file, writing the result to stdout.
+# Comment characters are replaced with spaces (newlines preserved) so
+# line numbers in the output still match the source file. String
+# literals are passed through untouched, including // and /* sequences
+# inside them. Returns non-zero when the file cannot be read, or when a
+# block comment is still open at end of input: an unterminated comment
+# would blank the rest of the file and hide any references in it, so
+# the strip fails and the caller fails closed (PR #7679 CodeRabbit
+# finding 4506377624).
+strip_jsonc_comments() {
+  awk '
+    BEGIN { in_str = 0; in_block = 0; esc = 0 }
+    {
+      out = ""
+      n = length($0)
+      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
+        c = substr($0, i, 1); d = substr($0, i + 1, 1)
+        if (in_block) {
+          if (c == "*" && d == "/") { in_block = 0; out = out "  "; i++ }
+          else { out = out " " }
+          continue
+        }
+        if (in_str) {
+          out = out c
+          if (esc) { esc = 0 }
+          else if (c == "\\") { esc = 1 }
+          else if (c == "\"") { in_str = 0 }
+          continue
+        }
+        if (c == "\"") { in_str = 1; out = out c; continue }
+        if (c == "/" && d == "/") {
+          for (j = i; j <= n; j++) out = out " "
+          i = n
+          break
+        }
+        if (c == "/" && d == "*") { in_block = 1; out = out "  "; i++; continue }
+        out = out c
+      }
+      print out
+    }
+    END { if (in_block) exit 1 }' "$1"
+}
+
+# Blank the entries of the top-level "disabled_providers" array in a
+# comment-stripped config, preserving line numbers: a tombstone entry
+# suppresses a retired provider, it does not use it.
+strip_disabled_providers() {
+  awk '
+    BEGIN { in_str = 0; esc = 0; awaiting_colon = 0; awaiting_bracket = 0; in_disabled = 0; depth = 0; objdepth = 0; str = "" }
+    {
+      out = ""
+      n = length($0)
+      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
+        c = substr($0, i, 1)
+        if (in_disabled) {
+          out = out " "
+          if (in_str) {
+            if (esc) { esc = 0 }
+            else if (c == "\\") { esc = 1 }
+            else if (c == "\"") { in_str = 0 }
+            continue
+          }
+          if (c == "\"") { in_str = 1; esc = 0; continue }
+          if (c == "[") { depth++; continue }
+          if (c == "]") { depth--; if (depth == 0) { in_disabled = 0 } continue }
+          continue
+        }
+        if (awaiting_colon) {
+          if (c == " " || c == "\t") { out = out c; continue }
+          if (c == ":") { awaiting_colon = 0; awaiting_bracket = 1; out = out c; continue }
+          awaiting_colon = 0
+        }
+        if (awaiting_bracket) {
+          if (c == " " || c == "\t") { out = out c; continue }
+          if (c == "[") { awaiting_bracket = 0; in_disabled = 1; depth = 1; out = out " "; continue }
+          awaiting_bracket = 0
+        }
+        if (in_str) {
+          out = out c
+          if (esc) { esc = 0 }
+          else if (c == "\\") { esc = 1 }
+          else if (c == "\"") { in_str = 0; if (str == "disabled_providers" && objdepth == 1) { awaiting_colon = 1 } str = "" }
+          else { str = str c }
+          continue
+        }
+        if (c == "\"") { in_str = 1; esc = 0; str = ""; out = out c; continue }
+        if (c == "{") { objdepth++ }
+        if (c == "}") { objdepth-- }
+        out = out c
+      }
+      print out
+    }' "$1"
+}
+
+repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+
+configs=()
+providers=()
+allow_empty=0
+
+while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
+  case "$1" in
+    --config)
+      if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then
+        echo "::error::--config requires a file path." >&2
+        exit 2
+      fi
+      configs+=("$2")
+      shift 2
+      ;;
+    --allow-empty)
+      allow_empty=1
+      shift
+      ;;
+    -h|--help)
+      usage
+      exit 0
+      ;;
+    -*)
+      echo "::error::Unknown option: $1" >&2
+      usage >&2
+      exit 2
+      ;;
+    *)
+      providers+=("$1")
+      shift
+      ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+if [[ ${#providers[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
+  echo "::error::At least one provider ID must be specified." >&2
+  usage >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+for provider in "${providers[@]}"; do
+  if [[ -z "$provider" ]]; then
+    echo "::error::Provider IDs must not be empty." >&2
+    usage >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+
+# Resolve candidate configs if none explicitly specified
+resolved_configs=()
+if [[ ${#configs[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
+  for cfg in "${configs[@]}"; do
+    if [[ ! -f "$cfg" ]]; then
+      echo "::error::Specified config file does not exist: $cfg" >&2
+      exit 2
+    fi
+    resolved_configs+=("$cfg")
+  done
+else
+  # Default paths checked for OpenCode configurations
+  default_candidates=(
+    "$repo_root/.opencode/opencode.jsonc"
+    "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/opencode/opencode.jsonc"
+    "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/opencode/opencode.jsonc"
+    "${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/opencode/opencode-runtime.jsonc"
+    # The deployed standing server's runtime overlay lives at a FIXED
+    # location (home/common/default.nix sets OPENCODE_CONFIG to
+    # %h/.local/state/opencode/opencode-runtime.jsonc) regardless of
+    # XDG_STATE_HOME, so always check that exact file too — an XDG
+    # override must not steer the gate away from the deployed overlay
+    # (PR #7679 Codex finding 4506371638).
+    "$HOME/.local/state/opencode/opencode-runtime.jsonc"
+  )
+  for candidate in "${default_candidates[@]}"; do
+    if [[ -f "$candidate" ]]; then
+      already=0
+      for existing in "${resolved_configs[@]}"; do
+        if [[ "$existing" == "$candidate" ]]; then already=1; break; fi
+      done
+      if [[ $already -eq 0 ]]; then
+        resolved_configs+=("$candidate")
+      fi
+    fi
+  done
+fi
+
+if [[ ${#resolved_configs[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
+  if [[ $allow_empty -eq 1 ]]; then
+    echo "Retirement gate OK: no configuration files found to check (--allow-empty)."
+    exit 0
+  fi
+  echo "::error::No OpenCode configuration files found to check." >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+total_violations=0
+
+for provider in "${providers[@]}"; do
+  provider_matches=0
+  for cfg in "${resolved_configs[@]}"; do
+    stripped_file="$(mktemp)"
+    if ! strip_jsonc_comments "$cfg" > "$stripped_file"; then
+      echo "::error::Config file '$cfg' could not be read/searched; failing closed (exit 2)." >&2
+      rm -f "$stripped_file"
+      exit 2
+    fi
+    filtered_file="$(mktemp)"
+    if ! strip_disabled_providers "$stripped_file" > "$filtered_file"; then
+      echo "::error::Config file '$cfg' could not be read/searched; failing closed (exit 2)." >&2
+      rm -f "$stripped_file" "$filtered_file"
+      exit 2
+    fi
+    rm -f "$stripped_file"
+    grep_status=0
+    matches="$(grep -nF -e "\"$provider\"" -e "\"$provider/" "$filtered_file")" || grep_status=$?
+    rm -f "$filtered_file"
+    if [[ $grep_status -eq 2 ]]; then
+      echo "::error::Config file '$cfg' could not be searched (grep error); failing closed (exit 2)." >&2
+      exit 2
+    fi
+    if [[ $grep_status -ne 0 && $grep_status -ne 1 ]]; then
+      echo "::error::Searching config file '$cfg' failed with unexpected status $grep_status; failing closed (exit 2)." >&2
+      exit 2
+    fi
+    if [[ $grep_status -eq 0 ]]; then
+      count="$(printf '%s\n' "$matches" | wc -l)"
+      echo "::error::Config file '$cfg' contains $count reference(s) to provider '$provider':" >&2
+      while IFS= read -r line; do
+        echo "  $line" >&2
+      done <<<"$matches"
+      provider_matches=$((provider_matches + count))
+    fi
+  done
+
+  if [[ $provider_matches -gt 0 ]]; then
+    echo "::error::Provider '$provider' has $provider_matches active reference(s) across configuration files. Retirement BLOCKED (#5610)." >&2
+    total_violations=$((total_violations + provider_matches))
+  else
+    echo "Retirement gate OK: no references to provider '$provider' found across ${#resolved_configs[@]} config file(s)."
+  fi
+done
+
+if [[ $total_violations -gt 0 ]]; then
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+exit 0

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Contract tests for check-provider-retirement-gate.sh (#5610).
+
+Verifies that the retirement gate blocks retiring a provider while
+configuration files still reference it, and passes once all
+references are gone.
+"""
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts" / "check-provider-retirement-gate.sh"
+
+
+def run_gate(args, env=None):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        ["bash", str(SCRIPT), *args],
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        check=False,
+        env=env,
+    )
+
+
+class TestCheckProviderRetirementGate(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_no_references_passes(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text('{\n  "model": "native-provider/model"\n}\n')
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode-route"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement gate OK", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_references_block_retirement(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "model": "opencode-route/workhorse",\n'
+                '  "small_model": "opencode-route/speed"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode-route"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement BLOCKED", result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("opencode-route/workhorse", result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("opencode-route/speed", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_multiple_files_checked(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            clean = Path(tmp) / "clean.jsonc"
+            clean.write_text('{\n  "model": "native/model"\n}\n')
+            dirty = Path(tmp) / "dirty.jsonc"
+            dirty.write_text('{\n  "agents": {"a": {"model": "opencode-route/scout"}}\n}\n')
+            result = run_gate(
+                ["--config", str(clean), "--config", str(dirty), "opencode-route"]
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement BLOCKED", result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn(str(dirty), result.stderr)
+
+    def test_multiple_providers(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text('{\n  "model": "old-provider/one"\n}\n')
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "old-provider", "new-provider"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("old-provider", result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement gate OK: no references to provider 'new-provider'", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_missing_config_is_error(self):
+        result = run_gate(["--config", "/nonexistent/opencode.jsonc", "opencode-route"])
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
+        self.assertIn("does not exist", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_no_provider_is_usage_error(self):
+        result = run_gate([])
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
+        self.assertIn("At least one provider ID", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_allow_empty_with_no_default_configs(self):
+        # Copy the script into an isolated tree whose repo root has no
+        # .opencode config, and point HOME/XDG dirs at an empty temp dir,
+        # so no default config resolves.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            root = Path(tmp) / "repo"
+            (root / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
+            isolated = root / "scripts" / SCRIPT.name
+            isolated.write_text(SCRIPT.read_text())
+            home = Path(tmp) / "home"
+            home.mkdir()
+            env = os.environ.copy()
+            env["HOME"] = str(home)
+            env["XDG_CONFIG_HOME"] = str(home / "config")
+            env["XDG_DATA_HOME"] = str(home / "data")
+            env["XDG_STATE_HOME"] = str(home / "state")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["bash", str(isolated), "--allow-empty", "opencode-route"],
+                text=True,
+                capture_output=True,
+                check=False,
+                env=env,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("--allow-empty", result.stdout)
+
+
+    def test_provider_id_substring_of_others_passes(self):
+        # Codex finding 4506371633 (PR #7679): matching is by provider
+        # identity, not substring. Retiring "opencode" must not be
+        # blocked by unrelated longer IDs or package names that merely
+        # contain it.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "model": "opencode-route/workhorse",\n'
+                '  "provider": {"opencode-go.drewrypope": {}},\n'
+                '  "plugin": ["@opencode/ai/providers/claude-code"]\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement gate OK", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_provider_identity_key_and_model_block(self):
+        # The identity forms that DO block: a provider key and a
+        # "<id>/<model>" reference.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "provider": {"opencode": {"options": {}}},\n'
+                '  "model": "opencode/some-model"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement BLOCKED", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_deployed_runtime_overlay_checked_despite_xdg_override(self):
+        # Codex finding 4506371638 (PR #7679): the deployed runtime
+        # overlay lives at the fixed $HOME/.local/state location
+        # (home/common/default.nix OPENCODE_CONFIG) even when
+        # XDG_STATE_HOME points elsewhere; the gate must check it.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            root = Path(tmp) / "repo"
+            (root / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
+            isolated = root / "scripts" / SCRIPT.name
+            isolated.write_text(SCRIPT.read_text())
+            home = Path(tmp) / "home"
+            overlay = home / ".local" / "state" / "opencode" / "opencode-runtime.jsonc"
+            overlay.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+            overlay.write_text('{\n  "model": "opencode-route/workhorse"\n}\n')
+            env = os.environ.copy()
+            env["HOME"] = str(home)
+            env["XDG_CONFIG_HOME"] = str(home / "config")
+            env["XDG_DATA_HOME"] = str(home / "data")
+            env["XDG_STATE_HOME"] = str(home / "other-state")
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["bash", str(isolated), "opencode-route"],
+                text=True,
+                capture_output=True,
+                check=False,
+                env=env,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn(str(overlay), result.stderr)
+
+    def test_comment_only_references_pass(self):
+        # Codex finding 4506184819 (PR #7679): a provider mentioned only
+        # in JSONC comments (retirement history) is not an active
+        # reference and must not block retirement.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  // openai-codex retired 2026-11-01; see history.\n'
+                '  /* opencode-route was here,\n'
+                '     multi-line note about opencode-route */\n'
+                '  "model": "native-provider/model"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            for provider in ("openai-codex", "opencode-route"):
+                result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), provider])
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, (provider, result.stderr))
+                self.assertIn("Retirement gate OK", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_value_reference_still_blocks_when_comments_present(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  // opencode-route mentioned in a comment\n'
+                '  "small_model": "opencode-route/speed"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode-route"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement BLOCKED", result.stderr)
+            self.assertIn("opencode-route/speed", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_slashes_inside_strings_are_not_comments(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:18750",\n'
+                '  "model": "opencode-route/workhorse"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "opencode-route"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("opencode-route/workhorse", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_disabled_providers_tombstone_passes(self):
+        # Codex finding 4506484591 (PR #7679): an entry in
+        # "disabled_providers" is a tombstone that SUPPRESSES a
+        # retired provider (removing it would reactivate the provider
+        # through the catalog); it is not an active reference and
+        # must not block that provider's retirement.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "disabled_providers": [\n'
+                '    "google-vertex",\n'
+                '    "openai-codex"\n'
+                '  ],\n'
+                '  "model": "native-provider/model"\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            for provider in ("google-vertex", "openai-codex"):
+                result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), provider])
+                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, (provider, result.stderr))
+                self.assertIn("Retirement gate OK", result.stdout)
+
+    def test_disabled_tombstone_plus_active_reference_blocks(self):
+        # The tombstone exclusion is scoped to the array: the same
+        # provider referenced as a real key elsewhere still blocks.
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="retirement-gate-") as tmp:
+            cfg = Path(tmp) / "opencode.jsonc"
+            cfg.write_text(
+                '{\n'
+                '  "disabled_providers": ["google-vertex"],\n'
+                '  "provider": {"google-vertex": {"options": {}}}\n'
+                '}\n'
+            )
+            result = run_gate(["--config", str(cfg), "google-vertex"])
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
+            self.assertIn("Retirement BLOCKED", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_nested_disabled_providers_array_is_not_a_tombstone(self):
+        # CodeRabbit finding 4506743525 (PR #7679): tombstone
